Recognizing the signs of a crash with Linda Yueh, Oxford University

Watch Now
east
Join Linda Yueh, Fellow in Economics at Oxford University, as she discusses insights from her book 'The Great Crashes: Lessons from Global Meltdowns and How to Prevent Them'. In this episode, Yueh outlines a three-step framework for identifying and mitigating financial crises, discusses the current economic landscape including potential risk areas like China's property sector, shadow banking, and high interest rates. She also explores the impact of big tech and decentralized finance on traditional financial systems and highlights the importance of competition and innovation in fostering economic growth. https://informaconnect.com/finovateeurope/
